title: Controllable Value Alignment in Large Language Models through Neuron-Level Editing

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to open-ended scenario prompts using an LLM evaluator (GPT-4.1-mini) to measure the Control Success Ratio (CSR) and unintended value leakage across the 10 basic human values defined by Schwartz's value theory (e.g., Achievement, Benevolence, Conformity).
